convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'iStochKomposter' (non-standard), includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position sizing and trade execution, and relies on custom CIsNewBar class from the included library

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: signal timestamp calculation for position open

other_exits: Opposite signal closes position: Up signal closes short, Dn signal closes long. Close signals are validated by scanning historical bars for prior opposite signals when both open and close on same side are enabled.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input value interpreted differently per mode.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a custom iStochKomposter indicator with 2 buffers: buffer 1=UpValue (buy signal), buffer 0=DnValue (sell signal). Signals are read from SignalBar (default bar 1, previous bar). When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no close signal is found on the current signal bar, the EA scans backward through historical bars to find a prior close signal. This ensures close signals propagate from earlier bars. The CIsNewBar class (from TradeAlgorithms.mqh) gates signal recalculation to new bars only. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean toggles allowing selective enable/disable of each trade direction and close action independently. Signal timestamps are computed as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for trade execution timing.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reverse-engineering the iStochKomposter custom indicator logic or finding its source code to reimplement in Python. The indicator appears to be a Stochastic with ATR-based level modification (given the name and params). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions - all need Python equivalents. Position sizing has 5 modes via MarginMode enum. The close-signal backward scan (lines 137-164) is non-trivial and must be faithfully reproduced. SignalBar=1 means signals lag by one bar, which is important for backtesting accuracy.
